Connect to devices on your network

Android requires permission before OmniTerm can connect directly to hosts on Wi‑Fi or Ethernet. This is used for SSH, files, monitoring, LAN discovery, tunnels, shares, and Wake-on-LAN. If you choose Not now, internet hosts remain available but nearby-device features may not work.
